borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Change of use from retail plant hire shop (Use Class E(a)) to motor repair workshop with hot food café (Sui Generis), and alterations including to the fenestration [Retrospective]
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of the proposed use and site layout, would fail to provide suitable access to the site, sufficient off-street parking, and fails to demonstrate an acceptable impact to the local highway network in the absence of an accurate Transport Statement. The development is therefore likely to add unacceptably to parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site and to have a negative impact on highway safety. The proposal is therefore found to be contrary to the following policies which together seek to ensure that proposals show how car parking will be designed and managed, to take into consideration on-street parking availability and existing and planned public transport provision, and to not negatively impact highway safety in particular through pedestrian and vehicular conflict:National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024)Policies T1, T4 and T6 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policies SP2, SP8 and DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)

In the absence of further information, the proposed development would result in additional noise and disturbance to nearby residential occupiers, to the detriment of their living conditions. The proposal fails to demonstrate how noise and other nuisance would be suitably mitigated and managed, and therefore fails to comply with the Agent of Change principle. The proposal would thereby cause undue harm to the living conditions of nearby occupiers, constituting unneighbourly development at odds with the following policies which seek to ensure that development proposals provide a high standard of amenity: National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024)Policies D6, D13 and D14 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMSI3 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)
